---
title: Callout type with quote and backslash
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
filters:
  - 15414-escape.lua
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['kind:\s*"say\\"hi\\\\there"']
        - []
      noErrors: true
---

A callout built with `quarto.Callout()` can carry any type string.
Quarto must escape the quote and the backslash in the Typst string that it passes as `kind`.
